messages:
luis: AcmeRetail RFI landed — they want a POC + license language + detailed encryption answers. I uploaded the RFI here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=acme_rfi_1759999999. Need: security questionnaire responses, capability matrix, POC timeline, pricing tiers. Can legal/product/eng review by EOD? :grimacing:
sarah.p: Saw it. Quick Q: do they explicitly require HSM integration? (Q14 in the doc asks for key custody model)
omar: Legal — link received. I'll start drafting license carveouts and privacy language. If HSM is required we need list of supported KMS/HSM providers and attestation options.
anya: Product: We support HSM patterns but it depends on deployment mode. Short capability matrix below (for RFI):
```
Mode | HSM | Data residency | SLA | Notes
Hosted | No* | Region-level | 99.9% | Envelope encryption; no customer HSM
Dedicated | Optional | Customer VPC | 99.95% | Customer KMS integration supported
Private | Yes | On-prem/VPC | Negotiable | On-prem or cloud HSM; attestation possible
```
luis: Nice. Omar — can you craft a 2–3 sentence HSM answer we can paste into the questionnaire? Also attaching our pricing sheet (per-token vs reserved) in the drive.
omar: Draft: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys in Dedicated and Private deployments; Hosted uses envelope encryption and platform-managed keys by default. For customers requiring HSM-backed custody, Private deployments can be configured with FIPS-certified HSM appliances or cloud KMS with HSM-backed key material; Redwood will coordinate attestation and procurement requirements." Posting to doc.
sarah.p: POC plan proposal: 2-week functional validation + 2-week load and quality baseline. We need: anonymized sample dataset, target QPS, latency SLOs, and acceptance criteria. Who owns infra provisioning?
david: I'll own infra for the POC. Need expected peak GPUs and an ops point of contact.
anya: On quantization: recommend int8 for Dedicated/Private for throughput gains; callout: may see 1–2% delta on edge-case benchmarks. Add as a caveat in the RFI.
luis: Great — I'll assemble the RFI package (capability matrix, HSM blurb, POC timeline, pricing). Can folks review final draft at 16:30? @omar @anya @david
omar: I'll review by 16:00.
david: Same.
anya: +1
salesbot: File uploaded: /drive/rfi/acme_rfi_1759999999.pdf
luis: Sending to Acme now. Will post any follow-ups in this thread. :thumbsup:
